stages.title: Orbital planning
stages.text: A first route from NASA orbital data. Large slopes and the rockfall zone are visible; small hazards are not.

stages.title: Rover reconnaissance
stages.text: The day before the walk, the rover drives the main route out and the backup route back. It finds soft ground the orbit could not see and the route is replanned.

stages.title: Drone inspection
stages.text: The simulated drone launches from the rover and images the scarp face and the areas the rover cannot reach, checking whether the observation point sits outside the rockfall zone.

stages.title: Astronaut mission review
stages.text: Review the proposed route two astronauts would walk to the observation point, the reconnaissance evidence behind it, and the backup route home. The simulated drone watches the scarp. None of this is crew clearance.

orbital: Plan unverified: small hazards are below orbital resolution
